name: Delivery Truck Simulator 2010
summary: Delivery Truck Simulator lets you run your own delivery company. Players can establish their own company and lead it to success. This is done by fulfilling tasks involving deliveries to earn money that can then be re-invested. The business can be expanded by buying new vehicles and adjusting them to the needs. Vehicles can be customized through paints jobs or money can be earned with advertisements on the trucks. Trucks need to be cared for through managing refueling and maintenance. The game includes ten different trucks that can all be controlled freely in the open game world.
